name: Opik
tagline: MCP-Native Agent Eval vs Open-Source SDK-Traced LLM Observability
oneLine: Open-source LLM observability and evaluation platform for AI agent tracing, LLM evaluation, prompt management, and production monitoring, built by Comet.
tldrVendor: Opik is the open-source LLM observability and evaluation platform for AI agent tracing, LLM evaluation, prompt management, and production monitoring, built by Comet. It is Apache-2.0 licensed and free to self-host as the full platform.

rows.vendor: Python and TypeScript SDKs with a @track decorator, framework integrations, a REST API, and OpenTelemetry.
rows.quote: When you add the @track decorator to a function, Opik will create a span for that function call and log the input parameters and function output for that function.

rows.vendor: Self-host via Docker Compose (opik.sh; MySQL, Redis, ClickHouse, MinIO) or a Kubernetes Helm chart for production.
rows.quote: Production ready Opik platform that runs on a Kubernetes cluster.

rows.vendor: In-process SDK instrumentation (decorator or integration) sends traces to the Opik server; OpenTelemetry supported.
rows.quote: Opik is framework-agnostic and supports its SDK, OpenTelemetry, and framework-specific integrations.

rows.vendor: LLM-as-a-judge natural-language assertions, 30+ pre-built metrics, custom metrics, annotation queues for human review.
rows.quote: Define natural-language assertions and let an LLM judge check them automatically.

rows.vendor: Token usage measured per trace; USD cost estimates for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Bedrock, Groq; custom cost settable.
rows.quote: Opik has been designed to track and monitor costs for your LLM applications by measuring token usage across all traces.

rows.vendor: Official MCP server (opik-mcp) lets Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code and others read traces, log scores, save prompts.
rows.quote: Plug your AI host (Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code Copilot, Codex, opencode, or any MCP client) directly into your Opik workspace: read traces, log scores, and save prompt versions, all from the chat.

rows.vendor: Apache 2.0 for the full platform (server, web app, evaluation); self-hosted deployments lack user-management features.
rows.quote: Opik is licensed under Apache 2.0. Its server, web application, and core observability and evaluation capabilities can be self-hosted without a commercial license.

rows.vendor: Built by Comet (Comet ML, Inc.), headquartered in New York City, launched 2017, with $70M in funding per its about page.
rows.quote: Headquartered in New York City, with Offices in Tel Aviv

rows.vendor: Web dashboard for traces, experiments, feedback scores, trace counts and token usage over time; online evaluation rules.
rows.quote: Scalable dashboards and online evaluation rules.

rows.vendor: Integrations: LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents, Pydantic AI, Vercel AI SDK, Google ADK, more.
rows.quote: Extensive 3rd-party integrations for easy observability: Seamlessly integrate with a growing list of frameworks, supporting many of the largest and most popular ones natively

rows.vendor: Prompt Library versions each change automatically and links the version that ran to its trace; retrieved via get_prompt.
rows.quote: The Prompt Library lets you manage them outside your codebase, version each change automatically, and link the exact version that ran to its trace.

rows.vendor: Enterprise plan lists SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 9001, HIPAA and GDPR compliance, single sign-on, and flexible deployments.
rows.quote: SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 9001, HIPAA, and GDPR compliance

vendorReasons.text: You need a fully Apache-2.0 platform you can self-host, backend included, without a commercial license.
You need native integrations for LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents and dozens of other frameworks.
You need a Prompt Library that versions every change and links the exact version to each trace.
You need estimated USD cost tracking per trace across OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Bedrock and Groq.
You need annotation queues for human-in-the-loop review alongside 30+ pre-built LLM-as-a-judge metrics.

faq.question: What is the difference between Iris and Opik?
faq.vendorPart: Opik is Comet's open-source LLM observability and evaluation platform: you instrument your app with its SDK or OpenTelemetry, and traces, experiments and prompts are managed in its dashboard.

faq.question: Is Iris better than Opik for MCP agent evaluation?
faq.vendorPart: Opik offers production monitoring dashboards with online evaluation rules, a Prompt Library with automatic versioning, estimated cost tracking, and a large set of native framework integrations.
